rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Integrates large language models with standard security testing tools through FastMCP to enable autonomous penetration testing workflows. Provides 14 tools covering network scanning, vulnerability exploitation, privilege escalation, and report generation. Uses Ollama as the LLM backend and exposes its server over HTTP/JSON-RPC for integration with MCP clients.
